title: Central Message Router (Refactor webhooks.ts)
goal: Replace primitive keyword-based routing in webhooks.ts with a central MessageRouter that routes by contact_type.
result_summary: Created MessageRouter class with route(contact, message, channel) method. Routes: UNKNOWN->UnknownIdentificationWorkflow, BUYER_TENANT->BuyerWorkflow, SELLER_LANDLORD->SellerWorkflow, PARTNER_AGENT->PartnerAgentWorkflow, MANAGEMENT->placeholder. Refactored webhooks.ts to use messageRouter.route() instead of inline isSellerFn logic. Also added inbound interaction logging and last_interaction timestamp updates.
